name: Chao luon
summary: Cháo lươn is a thin eel porridge, silky from whole rice grains and a little sticky rice, fragrant and hot with chili. One broth is sweet without the fat of a meat stock.
origin: Vinh. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam names cam Vinh and cháo lươn together. The city portal’s eight-specialty article and its 24 November 2022 eating day both put the bowl in the city.
culture: The city food-culture page says món lươn was recognized by Tổ chức Kỷ lục Châu Á as one of 12 Vietnamese dishes with an Asian record, and by Trung tâm sách Kỷ lục Việt Nam in a top 50. That is the city portal’s wording.
texture: The city portal says the rice is cooked as whole grains, not pounded or milled, with a little sticky rice so the porridge stays silky, and that the bowl is thin beside the duck and goat porridges it names.
taste: The city portal calls the cool-weather bowl fragrant and hot with chili. Người Lao Động calls the bone broth a sweetness without the fat of a meat stock.
howToEat: Mix the eel through the porridge. The city portal adds pepper, chili, and chopped scallion and rau răm, and says bánh mì or bánh mướt on the side. It says the bowl shows itself in cool weather. The 24 November 2022 city page treats it as the bowl that means you have arrived, at any meal.

Vietnamnet, 27 November 2023, soaks small field eel in rice water, boils it briefly, pulls the meat, and stir-fries it with shallot, turmeric, and chili. The bones are crushed, the liquid is strained, and that liquid is cooked into the porridge. The bowl is finished with rau ngổ, fried shallot, rau răm, tía tô, scallion, and pepper, plus vinegar chili or fresh chili. Người Lao Động, 13 February 2024, also crushes the bones into the pot and says the sweetness is not the fat of chicken, duck, pork, or beef. The city portal does not put the eel in the pot that way. Keep both.
where: The center. Người Lao Động names the citadel area. Báo Nghệ An names đường Hồ Sỹ Dương at night, with xôi, cháo gà, and miến ngan. A closing hour on that road was not printed. Check on arrival. A shop is not named. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
